achievements.name: We Got the Megatome
achievements.description: Retrieve the burdensome book of sinister sworcery from the darkness beneath Mingi Taw.

achievements.name: The Ballad of the Space Babies
achievements.description: Summon a slumbering sylvan sprite & send it skyward.

achievements.name: The Gold Trigon
achievements.description: Tame the cosmic geometry of The Gold Trigon in a sunlit meadow where angry bird sculptures loom.

achievements.name: The Dark Moon Trigon
achievements.description: Despite everything, tame the Dark Moon Trigon in a rain-soaked forest during a storm of thunder & lightning.

achievements.name: Assemble the Trigon Trifecta
achievements.description: Complete the three trigons in The Dark Moon Rock Show.

achievements.name: #honest
achievements.description: Complete the Scythian's woeful errand without cheating.

achievements.name: Monster Hunter
achievements.description: Find & somehow slay at least 7 lagomorphs, you jerk.

achievements.name: The Grizzled Boor
achievements.description: Feel free to take this opportunity to secretly self-identify as a principled, loving individual or a violent psychopath.

achievements.name: The Mushroom Kingdom
achievements.description: Experience the strange insight offered by a divinatory mushroom.

achievements.name: Cheating Cheater
achievements.description: Adjust your computer's date/time settings to access other moon phases & thus feel profound shame.

achievements.name: #moar
achievements.description: It has been said that something lurks within the White Stag of Scythia, wherever/whenever/whatever that might be.

achievements.name: The Moon Grotto
achievements.description: Use the Grizzled Boor's key to open the locked door to you-know-where.

achievements.name: The Bright Moon Trigon
achievements.description: Be awesome, get the Bright Moon Trigon from beneath an impossible island in the centre of a placid lake.

achievements.name: Now We Are Cosmic Friends Forever
achievements.description: Upload the Megatome at the summit of Mingi Taw & complete the Scythian's woeful errand.
